legal_name: Gainesville Environmental Film and Arts Festival

legal_status.ntee_category: Environmental Quality, Protection and Beautification / Environmental Education and Outdoor Survival Programs

mission: To provide environmental education to the public through film, arts, workshops, events, tours and any other forum or media. We strive to increase awareness of environmental practices that enhance public health and improve quality of life in urban, suburban and rural settings.

leadership.director_credentials: National award-winning investigative and environmental journalist and author. Published books include The Complete Idiot's Guide to Green Living (2007) and The Complete Idiot's Guide to Greening Your Business (Penguin, 2009). Past board member of the American Society of Journalists and Authors. Member of the Society of Environmental Journalists. Honorary member of the Golden Key International Honour Society. Also founded GoGreenNation.org and Green Drinks Gainesville.

staff.note: All key staff and board members report $0 compensation. Organization relies heavily on interns and volunteers representing an array of nationalities.

programs.name: Annual Environmental Film Festival
programs.description: Flagship program running since 2010. Screens independent environmental films from around the world with filmmaker Q&As, live discussions, and community events. Held in Gainesville with past satellite events in St. Augustine.

programs.name: Environmental Film Streaming Platform
programs.description: Year-round streaming platform at cinemaverde.org featuring curated environmental films from independent filmmakers worldwide. Available via web and Roku channel. Free to the public on Roku.

programs.name: Community Events
programs.description: Earth Day celebrations, community cleanups (e.g., Ashley Creek cleanup), local film screenings at venues like Cypress & Grove Brewing, sustainable showcases, and awards dinners.

programs.name: Sustainable Business Spotlight
programs.description: Program highlighting sustainable businesses committed to environmental practices.

partnerships: Cypress & Grove Brewing Company (recurring venue partner)

press_coverage.summary: International media coverage across environmental, business, and local outlets.
